summary: BUG FIX VERIFIED — Districts navigation now works. Directly tested the reported failure mode: tapping the TOP icon-plate area (where the decorative Gear sits) on district cards navigates correctly. Confirmed on 5 different districts (answerfier, author-anvil, bazaar, bluepaint, brainboost) — each opens /district/<slug>, renders the 'Inside {name}' section, and shows the district-back button. Nearby-district navigation also verified: from /district/answerfier tapped nearby-author-anvil which routed correctly to /district/author-anvil. Fix in src/components/Gear.tsx (pointerEvents moved from prop into StyleSheet.create → styles.wrap) is effective. Light regression: Feed like toggle icon+count changes on tap and reverts on second tap; Compose modal accepts input and the new post ('TEST_regression dispatch') appears in the feed. Bazaar chip filter + product detail + add-to-cart, HQ Lamplight theme toggle, and full bottom-tab nav were already comprehensively validated in iteration_1 (100% pass) and were not re-run this iteration (a stray click timeout occurred after the compose modal closed, unrelated to the current fix). No red screens; no new console errors introduced by the fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Correct fix: /app/frontend/src/components/Gear.tsx now sets pointerEvents inside StyleSheet.create (styles.wrap) instead of on the Animated.View prop. This is the New-Architecture-compatible way and prevents the decorative gear from swallowing taps on the district card's icon plate.
Gear is absolutely positioned inside the LinearGradient icon-plate with overflow:'hidden' — the pointerEvents:'none' style now lets Pressable receive the tap through the entire card surface.
No other places in the codebase use the deprecated `pointerEvents` PROP (grep clean). Districts.tsx and district/[slug].tsx untouched by the fix (only Gear.tsx changed), as expected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for targeted fix; regression items covered previously

seed_data_creation: 1 harmless TEST_-prefixed feed post created during compose regression check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for Districts navigation (Gear pointerEvents) confirmed working. Backend unchanged and previously 12/12. If re-running full regression, use tab testIDs tab-feed / tab-districts / tab-bazaar / tab-hq and be sure to wait ~500ms after closing the compose modal before tapping bottom tabs to avoid transient overlay interception during modal exit animation.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was the Gear component passing pointerEvents='none' as a PROP on Animated.View. Under React Native's New Architecture (Fabric on RN 0.74+), the pointerEvents PROP is deprecated and ignored on web/Fabric, so the absolutely-positioned decorative gear (rendered inside the district card's icon-plate) was receiving hit events and preventing the outer Pressable from firing. Mitigation: move pointerEvents into the style object created via StyleSheet.create, which is the supported location on New Architecture and continues to work on the legacy renderer. Verified by tapping the exact icon-plate area on multiple district cards and observing correct navigation.
